command:
cd /opt/week11/capstone
docker compose config --quiet
docker compose ps
docker compose exec -T --interactive=false backend id

docker network inspect week11-epicbook_back-tier --format 'Internal={{.Internal}} Containers={{range .Containers}}{{.Name}} {{end}}'
docker inspect week11-epicbook-database-1 --format 'Database host bindings={{json .HostConfig.PortBindings}}'
df -h /
